name: zcode-context-insight
description: See what every model request carries: context composition, per-step trend, full request browser, injections and compactions, file activity, the agent fleet, and cross-session insights — read-only and offline.

description_i18n.en: See what every model request carries: context composition, per-step trend, full request browser, injections and compactions, file activity, the agent fleet, and cross-session insights — read-only and offline.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 查看每次模型请求到底带了什么：上下文组成、逐请求趋势、完整请求浏览器、注入与压缩事件、文件活动、Agent 编队以及跨会话洞察——只读、离线。

dataRoot.title: ZCode CLI data directory
dataRoot.description: Optional directory containing db/, rollout/, debug/ and log/. Empty uses ~/.zcode/cli.

dbPath.title: Session database
dbPath.description: Optional absolute path to ZCode's db.sqlite. Empty uses <dataRoot>/db/db.sqlite.

contextWindow.title: Context-window override
contextWindow.description: Optional token window used when the model cannot be resolved from ZCode's provider config or the bundled model catalog. 0 = automatic.

priceFile.title: Custom price book
priceFile.description: Optional path to a JSON price book with the same shape as models.dev's providers map. Empty uses the bundled snapshot.
